body: Credibility-generated forward test (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.54 (naive sector base rate 0.53) that: Happy Forgings reports >=INR 450 cr of new orders won between 06-Nov-2026 and 31-Mar-2027 (target ~INR 500 cr). Probability set only by the pre-stated rule (research_notes/Promise tracker pilot/AUTO_COMPONENTS_peer_comparison.md section 5): p0 = 0.53 (leave-one-out peer strict delivery rate, category 'other', n=16); SAC +3.6 pts x weight 0.259 (N=7) -> p = 0.54. Evidence: Q2FY27 call (06-Nov-2026): 'by March, we will have orders of close to Rs.500 crores' (data-centre / heavy components); ~INR 300 cr data-centre orders already secured before the call (excluded). 'Close to 500' is read as >=90% of 500. Resolution: YES if the Q4 FY27 call/presentation (or NSE filings) states new orders/peak-annual business won after the Q2FY27 call and by 31-Mar-2027 totalling >=INR 450 cr (company's own figure; lifetime vs annual basis as the company states it, judged against the ~500 cr statement). Source: Happy Forgings Q4 FY27 earnings call transcript / investor presentation (NSE). Resolve by 2027-06-15; score with Brier vs the base rate, to test whether the credibility adjustment adds skill.

data.adjustment_applied: p0 = 0.53 (leave-one-out peer strict delivery rate, category 'other', n=16); SAC +3.6 pts x weight 0.259 (N=7) -> p = 0.54
data.adjustment_rule: p0 = leave-one-out pooled STRICT delivery rate (specificity-weighted share 'delivered'; partly=0) of the other 4 peers in the promise's category (all-category peer rate if <8 peer promises in that category). p = clip(p0 + N/(N+20) x SAC/100, 0.05, 0.95), N = company's scored promises, SAC in points (credit basis: delivered 1, partly 0.5; categories with n<5, or with <2 peers having data, pooled). P(base) = p0.
data.base_rate_reasoning: Naive forecaster = sector delivery rate for 'other' promises among the other auto-component peers (strict: delivered only, specificity-weighted; n=16). No company-specific information.
data.resolution_rule: YES if the Q4 FY27 call/presentation (or NSE filings) states new orders/peak-annual business won after the Q2FY27 call and by 31-Mar-2027 totalling >=INR 450 cr (company's own figure; lifetime vs annual basis as the company states it, judged against the ~500 cr statement).
data.resolution_source: Happy Forgings Q4 FY27 earnings call transcript / investor presentation (NSE)

title: Paper call: Happy Forgings reports >=INR 450 cr of new orders won between 06-Nov-2026 and 31-Mar-2027 (target ~INR 500 cr)
